convention: R=Rz(yaw)Ry(pitch)Rx(roll), matching existing states_from_rpy. Source field names specify RPY but hardware convention is not independently verified. Opposite composition RxRyRz is reported as sensitivity check.
method: acos((trace(R_current.T @ R_future)-1)/2), checked independently using unit-quaternion dot product.
